items.example: He finally kicked the habit of checking his phone at night.
After a month, getting up early became second nature.
I locked the door out of force of habit.
She still bites her nails — old habits die hard.
My grandfather is set in his ways and hates any change.
Travelling alone helped me break the mould.
I decided to shake things up and cycle to work.

items.idiom: get into the swing of things
items.example: It took me a week to get into the swing of things at the new job.
After the holidays I fell back into old habits.
In January he turned over a new leaf and joined a gym.
A weekend in the countryside was a welcome change of pace.
She cooks the same meals day in, day out.
Every week at the office is the same old, same old.
Regular exercise helped her break the cycle of late nights.
